_meta.purpose: Fail-closed allowlist for NEAR AI Cloud model-node measurements. Values that are not independently published are tagged source=observed and must be treated as first-observation pins, not third-party proof.
_meta.os_image_hash_source: Phala Cloud OS image registry for dstack-nvidia-0.5.12: https://cloud.phala.com/dstack/0.5.12 (also listed at https://cloud.phala.com/verification/os-images).
_meta.mr_td_rtmr_source: observed from live NEAR AI Cloud TDX quotes on 2026-11-05 (Africa/Lagos). dstack does not publish a single MRTD/RTMR0-2 for a version: those registers also encode VM CPU/RAM/device config, so independent precomputation needs the exact VmConfig. Limitation documented in README.
_meta.rt_mr3: NOT pinned: includes instance-id and runtime events. Verified by event-log replay only.
_meta.compose_pin: Pinned value is sha256(app_compose with the single 'INSTANCE_LABEL=gpuNN' replaced by 'INSTANCE_LABEL=<INSTANCE_LABEL>'). The verifier still checks the RAW sha256(app_compose) against MRCONFIGID and the RTMR3 compose-hash event; only the allowlist compare is normalized. DeepSeek and GLM nodes normalize to the same host compose (dstack-nvidia-0.5.11 name); Qwen's differs (0.5.12 name).
_meta.os_image_hash_check: os_image_hash is read from the replayed RTMR3 'os-image-hash' event (measured), cross-checked against tcb_info, then compared to this pin.
_meta.coverage: Label 'Hardware + host stack verified' only if EVERY observed attestation entry for that signing_address passes. RTMR3 events include mr-kms and key-provider (pinned). The model-serving container is NOT measured. Key-management service (dstack KMS) is trusted for key custody across replicas.
_meta.compose_manager_digests: Accepted host compose-manager digests are published on Docker Hub under nearaidev/compose-manager. Pinned: sha256:6e035c8fb99c1d31f41760d25af178683a658cca4afd73cd0d366fbb5bf884be (tags include prod-20260702-8e07c35 / prod-rollback-20260925-… / staging-20260718-…) and sha256:a320bb4882341c8e19ef1944436f6591ed73303732009ed5db9f6db6c9da756a (tags prod-20261029-be649f8, staging-20261029-be649f8, staging-20261021-754d65c; confirmed via https://hub.docker.com/v2/repositories/nearaidev/compose-manager/tags on 2026-11-05 WAT). Current Docker Hub `latest`/`prod` as of that fetch was a0c07308… (2026-11-04) and is NOT yet observed on panel nodes, so not pinned. Verifier accepts any allowlisted digest set; shared-signer policy still requires EVERY observed replica for a key to pass.
_meta.rtmr3_kms: mr-kms and key-provider RTMR3 event payloads are pinned (observed identical across all 3 panel models on 2026-11-05). key-provider payload decodes to JSON {name:kms,id:<secp256r1 pubkey>}. Signing keys are issued by this KMS service; a signature cannot prove which replica held the key. See README Limits.

rt_mr0.note: RTMR0 encodes VM shape. Primary value = 64 vCPU / 8 GPU VMs (all 3 models). also_observed = a 12 vCPU / 1 GPU Qwen replica seen 2026-11-05 ~11:40 WAT that serves the SAME signing_address 0x835a..aa26 (signing key is shared across replicas); MRTD and RTMR1/2 identical.

mr_kms.note: Identical across Qwen/DeepSeek/GLM model-node RTMR3 events on 2026-11-05 WAT.

key_provider.note: Identical across panel models. Signing keys come from this KMS; replica identity is not in the signature.
